fields.title: Week of Oct 20 – Oct 26
fields.headline: $1.42M of spend sits with one at-risk supplier; two more are slipping.
fields.body:
**At risk — $1.42M**
- **Altura Green Coffee** ($1.42M, contract to Mar 31): two lots over moisture spec, a freight surcharge 4.6% over contract.

**Watch closely**
- **Pacific Pulp Packaging** ($940K, ends Dec 31): late deliveries and a resin surcharge; we have no backup for 12 oz cups.
- **Northline Refrigerated Freight** ($610K, ends Jan 31): three cold-chain breaks.

**Changed since last week**
- Summit Espresso finished all 38 café visits.

fields.title: Week of Oct 27 – Nov 2
fields.headline: $2.97M of annual spend is at risk; Pacific Pulp and Northline turned red.
fields.body:
**Spend at risk: $2.97M** with 3 of 14 suppliers (42% of $7.15M), up from $1.42M.

**At risk**
- **Pacific Pulp Packaging** — $940K, contract ends Dec 31, score 30. 78% on time, 2.4% of lids cracked, single source for 12 oz cups. Actions: qualify a second supplier by Nov 20; lid credit — **overdue since Nov 3**.
- **Northline Refrigerated Freight** — $610K, ends Jan 31, score 38. 21% of invoices with charges not on the PO; three cold-chain breaks. Action: audit by Nov 12.
- **Altura Green Coffee** — $1.42M, ends Mar 31, score 36. Surcharge 4.6% over contract; harvest three weeks late. Action: dispute the surcharge by Nov 14.

**Watch, contract ending within 90 days**
- Valley Oat ($780K, Dec 15, score 68) and Ironleaf Roaster Parts ($180K, Jan 20, score 54).

**Decisions for Monday**
1. Approve the cup RFQ to three makers.
2. Hold Northline’s nine disputed invoices.
3. Renew Valley Oat only at the contract price.
